controls: Use the published 13.2 meV energy, archived crystal orientations, three cuts, recorded scan positions, Gaussian probe, intensity coefficients from four other maps, reflection lists and fitting procedure for both models. Also evaluate both predictions directly at the cut positions under the same settings.
limit: All maps were previously examined. The periodic network includes neighboring walls and residual displacement in the domains. The comparison concerns measured diffraction widths and profiles at the specified probe and material settings.
primary: Mean over six higher-twist maps of the absolute prediction error in the map-mean first-minus-second fitted width, on the original matched section IDs. Use only walls where the measured and both predicted widths qualify in both orders.
